checks.how: track the foreground astronaut through takeoff, apex and landing of the leap around 8.5s and convert pixels to metres against the known height of the life-support backpack or suited figure visible in the same frames
checks.what: downward acceleration of the foreground astronaut during the prolonged airborne leap
checks.why: a body in free flight with nothing holding it up must accelerate downward at the local gravity, so a floaty long hang time distinguishes lunar gravity from Earth gravity

claim: Two figures in bulky white spacesuits with backpacks hop and leap with long airborne phases on a grey cratered plain under a black sky, as if on the lunar surface.
not_realistic_if: Not realistic if the measured downward acceleration is close to Earth gravity, with a short fast fall.
question: Was this really filmed in lunar gravity?
realistic_if: Realistic if the measured downward acceleration matches the Moon's gravity within uncertainty, with a prolonged floaty flight.
